# Filter container metrics with timestamp
container_metric_df = metric_df[metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.contains(r'\.', na=False)].copy()

container_metric_df = container_metric_df[container_metric_df['pod_name'].isin(root_cause_components)]

# Filter node metrics with timestamp
node_metric_df = metric_df[(metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.startswith('node-', na=False)) & (~metric_df['cmdb_id'].str.contains(r'\.', na=False))].copy()
node_metric_df = node_metric_df[node_metric_df['cmdb_id'].isin(root_cause_components)]

# Convert timestamp to datetime with timezone Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
import pytz
container_metric_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(container_metric_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')
node_metric_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(node_metric_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert('Asia/Shanghai')

# Define failure time window in Asia/Shanghai timezone
start_time = pd.Timestamp('2022-03-20 09:30:00', tz='Asia/Shanghai')
end_time = pd.Timestamp('2022-03-20 10:00:00', tz='Asia/Shanghai')

# Filter data within failure time window
container_window = container_metric_df[(container_metric_df['datetime'] >= start_time) & (container_metric_df['datetime'] <= end_time)]
node_window = node_metric_df[(node_metric_df['datetime'] >= start_time) & (node_metric_df['datetime'] <= end_time)]

# Calculate global P5 thresholds for container and node metrics (similar to P95)
container_grouped_all = container_metric_df.groupby(['pod_name', 'kpi_name'])['value']
container_p5 = container_grouped_all.quantile(0.05).reset_index()
container_p5.rename(columns={'pod_name': 'component', 'value': 'p5_threshold'}, inplace=True)

node_grouped_all = node_metric_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'kpi_name'])['value']
node_p5 = node_grouped_all.quantile(0.05).reset_index()
node_p5.rename(columns={'cmdb_id': 'component', 'value': 'p5_threshold'}, inplace=True)

# Merge P95 and P5 thresholds for container and node
container_thresholds_full = pd.merge(container_thresholds, container_p5, on=['component', 'kpi_name'])
node_thresholds_full = pd.merge(node_thresholds, node_p5, on=['component', 'kpi_name'])

# Function to detect anomalies exceeding P95 or below P5 thresholds
def detect_anomalies(df, thresholds_df, component_col):
    df = df.copy()
    df = df.rename(columns={component_col: 'component'})
    df = df.merge(thresholds_df, on=['component', 'kpi_name'], how='left')
    # Identify anomalies
    anomalies = df[(df['value'] > df['p95_threshold']) | (df['value'] < df['p5_threshold'])]
    # Select relevant columns
    anomalies = anomalies[['component', 'kpi_name', 'datetime', 'value', 'p5_threshold', 'p95_threshold']]
    return anomalies

# Detect anomalies in container and node data within failure window
container_anomalies = detect_anomalies(container_window, container_thresholds_full, 'pod_name')
node_anomalies = detect_anomalies(node_window, node_thresholds_full, 'cmdb_id')

# Summarize anomalies by component, KPI, and timestamp

node_anomalies_summary = node_anomalies.sort_values(['component', 'kpi_name', 'datetime']).reset_index(drop=True)
